item.title: I believe the only solution to Marion County’s overdevelopment is a change in leadership.
item.description: "I am one of many who is astounded at the careless overdevelopment here in Marion County. Absolutely nothing is going to change until we kick out the current county commissioners. Yes, folks, that means going to vote for new ones. I know voting has become difficult, especially with Governor DeSantis doing all he can to frustrate voters.
